name: Giant Octopus
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. No languages.
appearance: A reddish brown octopus with eight curling arms and rows of pale suckers.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, The Rise of Tiamat Online Supplement v0.2, p. 16.
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 1 hour out of water.
Underwater Camouflage. It has advantage on underwater Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Water Breathing. It can breathe only underwater.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit is grappled (escape DC 16) and remains restrained until the grapple ends. The octopus cannot use Tentacles on another target during that grapple.
Ink Cloud (recharges after a short or long rest). If the octopus is underwater, it releases ink in a 20-ft. radius around itself. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute. A significant current can disperse the ink. After releasing it, the octopus can Dash as a bonus action.

name: Polar Bear
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A heavy cream-white bear with a long muzzle, rounded ears, and broad paws.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, The Rise of Tiamat Online Supplement v0.2, p. 22.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

name: Warhorse
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 11. No listed skills, special senses, or languages.
appearance: A bay horse with a dark mane, tail, and lower legs.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, The Rise of Tiamat Online Supplement v0.2, p. 26.
sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. If the horse moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Hooves on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the horse can make another Hooves attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printing note: This supplement v0.2 prints Hooves at +4 to hit on p. 26. The separate 2014 Monster Manual errata changes its own Warhorse on p. 340 to +6. This entry follows the supplement.

name: Wolf
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A gray-brown wolf with pointed ears, a pale throat and legs, and a thick tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, The Rise of Tiamat Online Supplement v0.2, p. 27.
sections.Traits:
Keen Hearing and Smell. The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
Pack Tactics. It has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of that creature.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 11 Strength save or fall prone.
